horoscope: Don't jump to conclusions without knowing the full story today. The Moon's transit through Gemini may bring useful connections through friends and social contacts. Put your energy into the right things and don't let negative comments bring you down. Your sense of humour could also help make things lighter around you.
love: With the Moon’s influence, it’s time to forget about your old relationships and previous feelings. Accepting the past will help you feel relaxed and open to a new approach to relationships. Our astrologer advises taking lessons from your past, then moving forward in any relationship.
finance: With the influence of Venus, today is a good day for finance. Your old strategy starts yielding profits today. Jobholders may get some support from official persons. Long-term investment is good for you, but don't invest without knowledge. Astrotalk’s astrologer advises you to save some money from your income.
career: Some people at work may criticise you or try to bring down your confidence today. Don't let their comments distract you from what you need to do. Our astrologers suggest spending less time worrying about other people's shortcomings and more time improving your own work.
health: With the influence of Mars, your energy will be amazing today. Utilise this energy in worthwhile things. A long run or light walk will be good for you. The Sun’s influence may increase your self-confidence, but also be careful about your abilities. Our astrologers advise you to warm up your body before any exercise and drink plenty of water.
